::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
IIT Madras spin-off (G.S. Madhusudan, Neel Gala) commercialising RISC-V processor cores derived from the SHAKTI programme. Its SoC Generator platform produced a six-core heterogeneous RISC-V test chip on TSMC 40nm, silicon-validated in June 2025.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Configurable RISC-V core generators (Azurite, Calcite), an automated SoC Generator, and licensable reference SoCs; its DLI project is a multi-core superscalar RISC-V processor for smartphones and edge AI.
